name: qaas-platform-dev
description: Spec-driven development guide for Smoke-team developers building the QaaS platform (TheSmokeTeam C#/.NET monorepo). Begins with a mandatory Know QaaS ecosystem-context stage, then uses the multi-repo map, knowledge graph, dependency and release ripple, Type A reflection hooks vs Type B framework core, and independently reviewed exact implementation plans before feature or bugfix work. Delegates in-repo detail to each repo's CLAUDE.md and live sources.
